result.brief: 用循环自编码器在含噪自然视频上重建，发现时间记忆自发产生序列依赖，为视频表征中的时间整合与去噪提供规范性解释。
result.reason: Recurrent autoencoder trained on noisy natural videos learns temporal memory; a video representation/denoising study, but framed as neuroscience account of serial dependence rather than a world-model or representation contribution.
